article_content: A glass pane at Tower Bridge's newly opened transparent walkway, 140ft above the River Thames, has been damaged after a visitor accidentally dropped a bottle of beer. Just two weeks after the attraction opened, one of the six half-tonne glass panes that make up the floor was damaged by visitors. The dropped bottle of beer caused an initial crack, but a woman walking over the broken glass in stiletto heels reportedly caused the pane to shatter further. The walkway is made up of five layers of glass in each pane, and the top layer was designed to be easily replaceable in the event of scratches or damage.

Apenas duas semanas após a atração ser aberta, um dos seis painéis de vidro de meia tonelada que compõem o piso foi danificado por visitantes. A garrafa de cerveja derrubada causou uma rachadura inicial, mas uma mulher caminhando sobre o vidro quebrado em saltos altos relatadamente causou o painel a se esfacelar ainda mais. A passarela é composta por cinco camadas de vidro em cada painel, e a camada superior foi projetada para ser facilmente substituída em caso de riscos ou danos.

article_content: A new book has made a shocking claim about the disappearance of Lord Lucan, one of Britain's most wanted criminals. According to the book, Lucan was smuggled out of the country by a former MI5 agent who was financed by his wealthy friends. The agent, known as James Gurney, allegedly helped Lucan escape to a remote Greek monastery after the murder of his children's nanny, Sandra Rivett, in 1974. The book claims that Lucan was part of an exclusive group of Britain's richest gamblers and socialites, known as the Clermont Set, who met at the Clermont Club in London's Mayfair. The group allegedly enlisted a right-wing private army, known as the Troops of Midian, to help Lucan disappear. Gurney's diary entries, which were shown to the book's author, Richard Wilmott, detail how Lucan was moved around the country, from a hotel to a pub, and then to a safe house, before being spirited out of the country. Lucan allegedly shaved off his moustache, applied fake tan, and bleached his hair before boarding a flight from Heathrow with a fake passport. He then hid out in remote safe houses and fishing boats in Greece before making his way to the Moni Kapsa monastery in Crete, where he was allegedly given sanctuary. The book's author, Richard Wilmott, claims to have solved the 40-year mystery of what happened to the missing peer.

article_content: Arsene Wenger stood by his decision to play Mesut Ozil, despite criticism, and it paid off as the German scored his first goal of the season in a 3-0 win at Aston Villa. Ozil also assisted in Danny Welbeck's first goal for the club, since his £16million move from Manchester United. The victory was sealed after just 36 minutes, with Aly Cissokho's own goal completing the scoring. Wenger's faith in his £42.5m record buy was justified, as Ozil responded well to scrutiny.

article_content: It was the goal that broke a thousand Chelsea hearts. Almost three years ago, Andreas Iniesta fired an incredible shot in the nail-biting final moments of a European Champions League semifinal at Stamford Bridge, securing a 1-1 draw and putting Barcelona into the final on away goals. Iniesta's ecstatic team then took the title in Rome, beating Chelsea's English rivals Manchester United. On Wednesday, the Spanish champions will return to London to face Chelsea for the first time since that fateful day on May 6, 2009 in the first leg of this season's semifinal. Unsurprisingly, talk has centered on that goal, with 2010 World Cup winner Iniesta adamant that this time around Barca will not settle for a draw.

Quase três anos atrás, Andreas Iniesta marcou um golo incrível nos momentos finais de uma semifinal da Liga dos Campeões da Europa em Stamford Bridge, garantindo um empate 1-1 e colocando o Barcelona na final por gols fora de casa. A equipe eufórica de Iniesta então conquistou o título em Roma, derrotando os rivais ingleses do Chelsea, o Manchester United. Na quarta-feira, os campeões espanhóis voltarão a Londres para enfrentar o Chelsea pela primeira vez desde aquele dia fatídico de 6 de maio de 2009 na primeira partida da semifinal desta temporada. Não é surpreendente que a conversa tenha girado em torno daquele gol, com o vencedor da Copa do Mundo de 2010, Iniesta, insistindo que desta vez o Barça não se contentará com um empate.

His father, Anthony, held down three jobs to support his son's racing career. Despite the challenges, Hamilton persevered and eventually achieved his dream of becoming a professional racing driver.
